sam-cs: Heads-up: Halcyon running into onboarding 429s. Their SPA spins up multiple widgets and the startup path triggers a handshake storm. Can we triage?
elena-sdk: which SDK version + embed pattern?
sam-cs: SDK v1.2.0 (browser). They inline the script and call init for each widget. Error: HTTP 429 "rate_limited" around /v1/handshake and occasional "prefetch failed". Repro when ~10 tabs/windows open quickly.
raj-sre: do we know auth type and token TTL? Also their edge/proxy behavior?
sam-cs: They're using short-lived ephemerals from their auth (TTL ~45s). Edge terminates TLS and seems to open new upstream connections per request (no keep-alive pooling).
elena-sdk: TTL 45s is the core problem. Browser flow: each widget/tab does preflight + token refresh when TTL approaches expiration; with short TTL and simultaneous starts you get a thundering herd. Recommended immediate changes: increase ephemeral TTL to >=300s, reduce per-widget maxConcurrency, and add client-side splay.
sam-cs: here's their init snippet they pasted: ```<script src="https://cdn.redwood.ai/sdk.js"></script> <script>Redwood.init({ token: window.__HAL_TOKEN, mode: 'embed', maxConcurrency: 8 })</script>```
raj-sre: confirm proxy keep-alive. Without upstream connection reuse we observe connection churn which triggers our ingress anti-stampede counters. Ask them to enable HTTP keep-alive / connection pooling or enable a connection pool in the edge.
elena-sdk: short-term SDK mitigations: we can land a client patch that coalesces preflights across tabs using a localStorage mutex + randomized backoff, and skip preflight if another context already has a valid handshake. I can cut v1.2.1 branch with this change tomorrow morning.
sam-cs: good. What do we want Halcyon to run for diagnostics?
raj-sre: ask for a curl of the handshake from their environment and a sample of the request headers (User-Agent, Connection). Example: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/handshake```
raj-sre: expected minimal handshake headers: ```POST /v1/handshake HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>
User-Agent: RedwoodBrowser/1.2.0
Connection: keep-alive
```
sam-cs: noted. Halcyon will run curl and capture headers; they scheduled a 30m session at 11:00 PT. I'll join to capture logs.
ops-bot: admin-note: temporary handshake-relax applied to acct halcyon-corp (id 9001001) by raj-sre at 1816001450. ticket# CS-8344. duration=72h.
elena-sdk: dev action: (1) implement localStorage mutex + jitter and PR v1.2.1, (2) document client-side backoff guidance for SPA embeds.
raj-sre: infra action: (1) monitor ingress 429 + handshake error rate for acct 9001001, (2) liaise with Halcyon for proxy keepalive configuration.
sam-cs: customer action: change TTL to >=300s if possible, set maxConcurrency to 2 for now, enable keep-alive and run the curl test.
els: thanks team. Will report back after the 11am session. :thumbsup:
